title: tanacetum haussknechtii
intro: Tanacetum haussknechtii, commonly known as Haussknecht's tansy, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum haussknechtii include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as treating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
